tasks.label: PlatformIO Build
tasks.command: if (Get-Command pio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pio run } elseif (Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe") { & "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe" run } else { throw "PlatformIO (pio) non trovato nel PATH o in ~/.platformio/penv/Scripts" }

tasks.label: PlatformIO Upload
tasks.command: if (Get-Command pio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pio run --target upload } elseif (Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe") { & "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe" run --target upload } else { throw "PlatformIO (pio) non trovato nel PATH o in ~/.platformio/penv/Scripts" }

tasks.label: PlatformIO Clean
tasks.command: if (Get-Command pio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pio run --target clean } elseif (Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe") { & "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe" run --target clean } else { throw "PlatformIO (pio) non trovato nel PATH o in ~/.platformio/penv/Scripts" }

tasks.label: PlatformIO Monitor
tasks.command: if (Get-Command pio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pio device monitor --environment esp32dev } elseif (Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\platformio.exe") { & "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\platformio.exe" device monitor --environment esp32dev } else { throw "PlatformIO (pio) non trovato nel PATH o in ~/.platformio/penv/Scripts" }

tasks.label: Build firmware (esp32dev)
tasks.command: if (Get-Command pio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pio run -e esp32dev } elseif (Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe") { & "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe" run -e esp32dev } else { throw "PlatformIO (pio) non trovato nel PATH o in ~/.platformio/penv/Scripts" }

tasks.label: PlatformIO Upload FS
tasks.command: if (Get-Command pio -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { pio run --target uploadfs } elseif (Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe") { & "$env:USERPROFILE\.platformio\penv\Scripts\pio.exe" run --target uploadfs } else { throw "PlatformIO (pio) non trovato nel PATH o in ~/.platformio/penv/Scripts" }
